item.title: Excavator destroyed medieval grain silos in Strovolos — and no one was held accountable
item.description: Ancient grain silos dating from the medieval period were damaged by an excavator during sewage works in Strovolos in 2006 and will remain buried underground, a parliamentary committee heard on Wednesday. item.title: Online only, one chance left: Cyprus vehicle licence renewal deadline is 11 March
